sections.Profile:
The "Double-Shuffle" pinball machine, released by D. Gottlieb & Co. in June 1949, is a single-player, electro-mechanical game designed by Harry Mabs, with artwork by Roy Parker.

- Manufacturer: D. Gottlieb & Co.
- Years made: 1949
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Lights
- Players: 1
- Tags: Single Player, Wood Rail, Original Theme, Shuffleboard, Recreation, Games
